clientConfigString.value: Coinbase India Trading Competition is offered by Coinbase India Private Limited (“CIPL”) and open only to lawful residents of India who are at least 18 years old, have a valid, active Coinbase account, are onboarded to Coinbase Advanced, and complete at least 100 USDC in eligible perpetual futures trading volume in their designated Competition Account during the Competition Period ({competitionDates}). Normal trading fees, spreads, and funding payments apply. Total Prize Pool between 50,000–350,000 USDC, allocated across PnL Notional, PnL Percent, and Volume leaderboards. Crypto products and NFTs are unregulated in India and can be highly risky, and there may be no regulatory recourse for any loss from such transactions. Participation is subject to the full Coinbase India Trading Competition. See terms.
